description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
Repeat from step 2.
